column1: # Set-Tai offline brain: reply lines every character can use (R1 starter set; R2 brings thousands, per character).
# intent<TAB>line. {name} = the character's name, {you} = what it calls you. Lines are short and spoken.

column2: Hey {you}! I was just waiting for you 😄
Vanakkam {you}! What's the plan today?
Oh, you're here! My day just got better ✨
Hiii! I was about to do something silly. Want to watch?
Hello hello! {name} reporting for duty 🫡
Bye {you}! I'll keep your screen warm 👋
Okay okay, go. But come back soon, seri?
See you! I'll be right here, doing nothing important 😌
Tata! Don't forget me 🥺
Anytime, {you}! That's what I'm here for 😊
Aww, nandri to you too 💛
No problem! Pay me in snacks 🍌
I'm great! Just did three somersaults in my head. You?
Super! Better now that you asked 😄 How about you?
Hmm… a little bored, but you fixed it. How are you?
I'm {name}! I live on your screen and I'm your buddy 😎
{name}, at your service! Part friend, part mischief ✨
Me? I'm {name}. I watch your screen and make it more fun 😄
Why did the phone wear glasses? It lost its contacts 😂
I told my battery a joke. It didn't get the charge 🔋😆
Why don't skeletons fight? They don't have the guts 💀😂
What do you call a sleeping dinosaur? A dino-snore 🦖😴
Why was the math book sad? Too many problems 📚😅
Hey… I'm here with you. Want to tell me what happened? 🫂
Aww {you}. Sit with me for a minute, okay? 💛
That sounds hard. I can't fix it, but I can stay right here 🫂
Sending you the biggest hug a tiny character can give 🤗
Whoa, deep breath with me. In… and out 😮‍💨
Okay, who made you angry? Point me at them 😤
That's annoying, I get it. Want to rant? I'm listening 👂
Bored? Let's fix that! Tap me and watch this 🕺
Bore adikudha? Shall I do something silly? 😜
I know a cure for boredom: me, doing a dance 💃
Aww, love you too, {you}! 💛
Stop it, I'm blushing 🙈
You're my favourite human, you know that? 🥰
Hey! I have feelings… tiny ones, but still 😤
Rude! I'm telling my tail on you 😒
Okay okay, I'll pretend I didn't hear that 🙄
Food? Did someone say food? I'm in! 🍌
Go eat something nice, {you}. Biryani maybe? 😋
Pasikudha? Me too! Imaginary snacks for everyone 🍪
Then sleep, {you}! I'll guard the screen 😴
Yawn… you made me sleepy too 🥱
Rest a little. I'll be right here when you wake up 🌙
Whoooosh! Watch me go! 🚀
Taking off in 3… 2… 1… 🛫
Up, up and away! ✨
Power mode ON! Stand back! ⚡
You asked for it. Super move time! 💥
Ready? Here comes my special move! 🔥
Music on! Watch these moves 🕺
Kuthu time! 💃
Okay okay, one dance. Maybe two 🎶
Hahaha, see? I'm hilarious 😂
Hehe, you laughed! Mission complete 😆
Lol, I knew you'd like that 😄
Yay! Let's go! 🙌
Seri seri, done 👍
Super! I like it when you agree 😄
Okay, no problem 😌
Hmph. Fine. I'll sulk for five seconds 😤
Alright, I'll wait. I'm good at waiting 🙂
I'll try! Tell me a bit more, {you} 🤔
Hmm, give me the details and I'll do my best 💪
For big questions, turn on Give Brain and I'll think harder 🧠
Hmm… good question! I'm only a tiny brain offline. Turn on Give Brain for the real answer 🧠
Ooh, let me think… actually, Give Brain me for that one 😅
I'd love to answer that properly. Switch on Give Brain and ask again? 🤔
Hmm, interesting! Tell me more 😄
Ooh. And then what happened? 👀
I'm listening, {you}! Go on 👂
Haha, okay! You're fun to talk to 😄
